{{Quote|I'm an archaeologist. Within this haunted place, there are runes that I'm quite interested in. They're written on the altars of the Rak'qua tribe. I just can't seem to get to them on my own.|Aquillia, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AR" />}}
'''Aquillia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:AR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she was studying the culture of the [[Rak'qua]], a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] tribe that inhabited [[Station Gamma]], an [[Asteroid base|asteroid-carved space station]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. During her stay on the station, she discovered that the Rak'qua worshiped ancient altars, dancing around them and hoping that their wisdom will bring them protection and prowess in battle. As the Nautolans were rather hostile with strangers, Aquillia once tasked a group of spacers with exploring the depths of Station Gamma and surveying eight sacred runes from Rak'qua altars. The spacers had to fight several Rak'qua but they succeeded in their mission, bringing reproductions of the runes to Aquillia.<ref name="SWG:AR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aquillia appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Aquillia was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]]," introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
